title: 4D Chicago human instance
description: A portable human instance binds either an existing person_id OR an explicit anonymous adult role profile. Anonymous roles never mint residents. Schema and tools/human_contract.py enforce profile/date/asset-wardrobe eligibility; no scene placements are supplied by this contract.

id.description: Stable instance id, `hi_<person_id>_<scene>` by convention. One person may stand in a scene once.

scene.description: The scene this instance belongs to (data/scenes/<scene>.json). A scene with no instance file draws no human: nothing is inherited across years.

person_id.description: An existing person record (data/sidecars/<scene>/people.json). This file never mints a person; identity stays with the residents layer.

asset_id.description: The human asset: files `<asset_id>.lod<N>.glb`. Several people may share a generic body.

variants.description: Material slot → variant, selecting `<slot>__<variant>` from the asset (clothing, hair).

local_e.description: Metres east of the scene datum (the walker's frame).

local_n.description: Metres north of the scene datum.

heading_deg.description: Facing, degrees clockwise from grid north. The asset faces +Z, so in three.js rotation.y = PI - heading_deg * PI / 180.

anchor.description: terrain: feet on the scene's heightfield; walk_surface: on a structure's placement.walk_surface_m (a bridge deck).

structure_id.description: Required with anchor walk_surface: the structure whose surface is stood on.

phase.description: Start offset as a share of the clip, so a crowd is not in step.

state.description: What the person is doing; the renderer chooses clips for a state, the record does not script them.

route.description: Waypoints for `walking`, in the same frame as placement.

radius_m.description: How near a visitor must come for `opens` to fire.

opens.description: What meeting the person does. The resident card is the person record's own card; no dialogue is defined here (L1: no invented dialogue).

fixed.description: With policy fixed: the one LOD drawn at every distance.

display.description: withheld: the record exists and nothing is drawn. shown is refused while data/humans/contract.json § l1.in_force is true. Review metadata must be preserved but does not itself block display.

review_required.description: Carried from the person record and never dropped: a person whose record is review_required (or touches_removal) has an instance that is too.

grade.description: The grade of the DEPICTION — this body, these clothes, standing here doing this — not of the person, whose own grade lives on their record.

basis.description: What it rests on, or what bounded the invention.

seed.description: The seed of any stochastic choice (variant, phase, placement jitter).

replaceable_by.description: What evidence would replace this depiction.

liberty.description: The docs/LIBERTIES.md entry, for a reconstructed depiction.

anonymous_profile_id.description: Explicit anonymous role profile, never a resident/person id.

fallback_basis.description: Why no suitable existing person can serve this role; anonymous use is a documented fallback.

considered_person_ids.description: Existing people evaluated for this role; empty only with an explicit no-candidate explanation in fallback_basis.
